bajnath1993_chloride_reversal@1.locator: Methods, Fig. 2 and accompanying Results, closed-to-open single-channel amplitudes.
bajnath1993_chloride_reversal@1.preparation: Forskolin-stimulated, cell-attached patches of human HT-29cl.19A epithelium at 25 °C. Pipette chloride was lowered with osmotic compensation.
bajnath1993_chloride_reversal@1.uncertainty: The high-chloride reversal was 2 ± 1 mV on the −Vₚ scale. The low-chloride endpoint was about 25 mV. No error on their difference was reported.

syme2000_rsk2_calcium@1.locator: Fig. 8C, filled circles, free-calcium dose series in the absence of chlorzoxazone.
syme2000_rsk2_calcium@1.preparation: Excised inside-out patch from a Xenopus oocyte expressing rat SK2. The readout is the number of active channels times open probability (NPₒ).
syme2000_rsk2_calcium@1.uncertainty: Fig. 8C gives a fitted midpoint and slope with no uncertainty or replication count. The drug series was recorded on the same patch; Fig. 8B’s n = 7 concerns another experiment.

oliver2000_rsk2_calcium_jumps@1.locator: Fig. 3A–B and pp. 596–597, recombinant SK2 recordings and the reported low-calcium rise time.
oliver2000_rsk2_calcium_jumps@1.preparation: Calcium jumps onto giant inside-out oocyte patches expressing SK2, −80 mV, solution exchange time constant ≤0.5 ms. Only recombinant-channel observations are included.
oliver2000_rsk2_calcium_jumps@1.uncertainty: High-dose values are means ± SD across ten patches. The low-dose time is approximate, with no sample count, error or matching washout/absolute plateau reported.
